method: Create a new script-opened document per sample, write one character at a time into an unfinished quoted start-tag attribute, then close and verify the attribute length. Four samples per size; discard the first and report the median of the remaining three. This measures only the write loop, not setup, completion or process startup.

validation.independentReview: Two token-boundary findings fixed; one targeted confirmation found no remaining issue.

limits: This is a local microbenchmark, not a cross-platform performance guarantee.
Unfinished comments, doctypes, end tags, script text and other lexical forms were not benchmarked.
A root document.open after a child script can detach the child; these timing samples do not measure frame lifecycle or rendering.
